description: Checks that scripts/hooks/commit-guard.mjs runs before every agent commit (PLAN.md section 10.4, 'Guard bootstrap'). A required check that fails, or whose tool is missing, blocks the commit. A check that is not required yet is reported as skipped until its tool exists. The task that adds a tool sets its check to required in the same commit.

checks.description: .gitignore has no line that mentions kiro, and git check-ignore does not ignore .kiro
A LICENSE file is in the index
No GitHub token, AWS access key ID or secret key assignment, PEM private key or Modal token on an added line of the staged diff
No staged .env or .env.* file other than .env.example
Every dependency in every staged package.json appears in backticks in the README section '## Pre-existing work'
No staged text file contains U+2014 (em dash)
npm run test:fast (vitest run with WRAITH_PBT_RUNS=20) exits 0
The core-integrity test passes: both apps import the same unmodified skeleton core
Every staged text file under apps/<name>/fixtures/ contains the label DEMO
